author: Sp4rrkii
body:
Hello, recently i have just finished my new Map, Locizoro. Here are the details as well as the pics! Constructive feedback would be greatly appreciated.

Details

Team sizes: 16 each
Team colours: Red vs Blue
Point system: 3 capture points each with a golden apple spawner Note: this will need to be changed to golden apples in XML as command blocks arent allowed on the server I built this map on. Also, while the point is being captured it will turn to that team's colour.

While the control point is captured that team will gain: 2 points per 5 seconds
Points per kill: 1
This game can played either first to 125 points or the most amount of points after a certain amount of time

Note: There are also Snipe towers/Shooting areas that have arrow spawners. Similar to the last spawners, they will need to be changed to arrow spawners as it cant be done without XML or command blocks.

Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/WNpzE
Thanks for taking a look <3 I spent a good amount of time on this.
